## Loading all required packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(ausflora)
library(austraits)
library(GGally)
library(multcompView)
library(networkD3)
library(MASS)
library(smatr)
```


## Importing and name-matching data
```{r}
vessel_areas <- read.csv("data/vessel_measurements.csv", header = T) |>  
  separate(Image, c("family_original", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species_name", "state", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |>
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000,
         radius = sqrt(Area.µm.2/pi))

resources <- load_taxonomic_resources()     # Used for ausflora functions

apc_names <- update_taxonomy(vessel_areas$species_name, resources = resources) |>
  filter(grepl("accepted|synonym|variant", taxonomicStatusClean)) 

# Updated taxonomy used for GBIF occurrence species name
# write.csv(apc_names["canonicalName"], "data/apc_names.csv", row.names = F)

gbif_names <- read.csv("data/gbif_namematched.csv", header = T) |> filter(grepl("SPECIES|VARIETY", rank)) 

namematched <- gbif_names |> dplyr::select(verbatimScientificName, species, genus) |> 
  left_join(apc_names[c("aligned_name", "canonicalName", "family")], by = c("verbatimScientificName" = "canonicalName")) |> 
  rename(species_name = aligned_name, gbif_name = species, apc_name = verbatimScientificName)

vessel_areas <- vessel_areas |> left_join(namematched, by = "species_name")

changed_taxonomy <- namematched |> filter(apc_name != species_name)
```




## Creating climate preference data
```{r}
# Filtering columns from GBIF occurrences for RAM and processing time consideration

# gbif_occurrences <- read.delim("data/gbif_raw_occs.csv", header=T, sep="\t")

gbif_filtered <- gbif_occurrences |>
  dplyr::select(species, scientificName, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude) |>
  drop_na()

write.csv(gbif_filtered, "data/gbif_filtered.csv", row.names = F)

# Creating point vector for each occurrence
gbif_filtered <- read.csv("data/gbif_filtered.csv", header = T) |> drop_na()
occurrence_points <- vect(gbif_filtered, geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"))

# Extracting climate values from each point
raster_list <- list.files("rasters_30s/", full.names = T) |> map(rast)

for (raster in raster_list) {
  gbif_filtered <- gbif_filtered |>
    mutate(!!sym(names(raster)) := terra::extract(raster, occurrence_points)[[2]])
}

occurrence_data <- gbif_filtered |> filter(species %in% namematched$gbif_name)

climate_preferences <- occurrence_data |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(MAP=mean(MAP, na.rm=T),
            MAT=mean(MAT, na.rm=T)) |>
  rename(gbif_name = species) |> 
  left_join(namematched[c("gbif_name", "apc_name", "genus", "family")], by = "gbif_name") |> 
  distinct()

write.csv(climate_preferences, "data/climate_preferences.csv", row.names = F)
```


Creating whittaker plot
```{r}
gbif_filtered_summary <- gbif_filtered |>
  group_by(scientificName) |>
  summarise(MAP = mean(MAP, na.rm = T),
            MAT = mean(MAT, na.rm = T))

write.csv(gbif_filtered_summary, "data/angiosperm_climate.csv", row.names = F)

gbif_filtered_summary <- read.csv("data/angiosperm_climate.csv", header = T)

ggplot() +
  geom_hex(data = gbif_filtered_summary, aes(x = MAT, y = MAP), bins = 15) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "light grey", high = "dark green", trans = "log") +
  geom_point(data = climate_preferences, aes(x = MAT, y =  MAP), size = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlim(5, 30) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Mean annual temperature (ºC)") +
  ylab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 16))

ggsave("figures/whittaker_plot.png", scale = 1.5, width = 7.34, height = 7.34, units = "cm")
```


## Calculating Dh and VLF
```{r}
xylem_Dh <- vessel_areas |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |>
  group_by(apc_name, genus, other) |> 
  summarise(sample_Dh = sum(radius^5)/ sum(radius^4)) |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(mean_Dh = mean(sample_Dh, na.rm=T)) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = "apc_name") |> 
  left_join(vessel_areas["apc_name"], by = "apc_name") |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(n_samples = n()) |> 
  drop_na() 

xylem_VLF <- vessel_areas |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  mutate(sample_lumen_area = max(Area.µm.2)) |> 
  filter(Name %in% c("vessel", "part")) |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  summarise(vessel_area = sum(Area.µm.2),
            sample_lumen_frac = vessel_area/sample_lumen_area) |> 
  distinct() |>
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(mean_VLF = mean(sample_lumen_frac, na.rm=T)*100) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = "apc_name") |> 
  left_join(vessel_areas["apc_name"], by = "apc_name") |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(n_samples = n()) |> 
  drop_na() 

ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = xylem_Dh |> filter(n_samples > 5), aes(MAP, col = genus)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

## Phylogenetic variation in vessel size and VLF
```{r}
generate_label_df <- function(TUKEY, variable){

     Tukey.levels <- TUKEY[[variable]][,4]
     Tukey.labels <- data.frame(multcompLetters(Tukey.levels)['Letters'])

     Tukey.labels$treatment=rownames(Tukey.labels)
     Tukey.labels=Tukey.labels[order(Tukey.labels$treatment) , ]
     return(Tukey.labels)
     }
 
Dh_aov <- aov(log(mean_Dh)~family, data = xylem_Dh)
summary(Dh_aov)
Dh_Tukey <- TukeyHSD(Dh_aov)

LABELS <- generate_label_df(Dh_Tukey , "family")

xylem_Dh <- xylem_Dh |> left_join(LABELS, by = c("family" = "treatment"))

family_n_labels <- xylem_Dh |> group_by(family) |> summarise(n = n())
family_n_labels$n <- paste("n =", family_n_labels$n)

Dh_family_plot <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = xylem_Dh, aes(fct_reorder(family, mean_Dh, median), mean_Dh)) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_text(data = xylem_Dh |> group_by(family, Letters) |> summarise(max_Dh = max(mean_Dh)), 
            aes(family, y = max_Dh + 20, label = Letters)) +
  geom_text(data = family_n_labels, aes(family, min(xylem_Dh$mean_Dh) - 4, label = n), size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  xlab("Family") +
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)") +
  coord_flip()

VLF_aov <- aov(log(mean_VLF)~family, data = xylem_VLF)
summary(VLF_aov)
VLF_Tukey <- TukeyHSD(VLF_aov)

# Phylogenetic differences
VLF_LABELS <- generate_label_df(VLF_Tukey, "family")

xylem_VLF <- xylem_VLF |> left_join(VLF_LABELS, by = c("family" = "treatment"))

VLF_family_plot <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = xylem_VLF, aes(fct_reorder(family, mean_VLF, median), mean_VLF)) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_text(data = xylem_VLF |> group_by(family, Letters) |> summarise(max_VLF = max(mean_VLF)),
            aes(family, y = max_VLF + 10, label = Letters)) +
  geom_text(data = family_n_labels, aes(family, min(xylem_VLF$mean_VLF) - 1, label = n), size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  xlab("Family") +
  ylab("VLF (%)") +
  coord_flip()

Dh_family_plot / VLF_family_plot + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")") & 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 10))


ggsave("figures/Dh_VLF_family.png", scale = 1, width = 15.92, height = 15.94, units = "cm")
```


## Phylogenetic differences in vessel size response to rainfall
```{r}
common_genera <- xylem_Dh |> group_by(family, genus) |> summarise(n = n()) |> filter(n > 5) |> pull("genus")

plot_interaction <- function(model, data) {
  model_p <- predict.lm(model, data, se.fit = T)
  
  pred_data <- bind_cols(data, model_p)
  
  return(pred_data)
}

## Family level
Dh_MAP_family_lm <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(MAP)*family, data = xylem_Dh)
summary(Dh_MAP_family_lm)
anova(Dh_MAP_family_lm)

Dh_family_pred <- plot_interaction(Dh_MAP_family_lm, xylem_Dh |> dplyr::select(mean_Dh, MAP, family))

Dh_family_sma <- sma(log(mean_Dh)~log(MAP)*family, xylem_Dh, method = "OLS")
print(Dh_family_sma, coefbygroup = T)

ggplot() +

  geom_point(data = xylem_Dh, aes(MAP, mean_Dh), size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~family, nrow = 2) +
  xlab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)") +
  ylab(D[h]~"(µm)") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

Dh_sma <- sma(log(mean_Dh)~log(MAP)*genus, xylem_Dh |> filter(n_samples > 5), method = "OLS")
```

## Sankey diagram for distribution of species in dataset
```{r}
links <- read.csv("data/sankey_links.csv", header = T)

nodes <- data.frame(
  name=c(as.character(links$source), 
  as.character(links$target)) %>% unique()
)

links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
 
p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
              Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
              Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
              sinksRight=FALSE, width = 600, height = 600, fontSize = 20, fontFamily = "Arial")

p

library(cowplot)

plot_grid(p, whittaker)
```

```{r}
data_dir <- "/Users/elijahmagistrado/OneDrive - UNSW/images"

  separate(file_name, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |> 
  filter(!grepl("/", species)) |>

  separate(file_name, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |> 
  filter(grepl("/", species)) |> 
  separate(species, c("other", "species"), sep = "/", extra = "merge") |> 
  separate(species, c("family2", "species"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |> 
  distinct(family, species)

  filter(grepl("accepted|synonym|variant", taxonomicStatusClean)) |> distinct(canonicalName)
```

## Zanne et al. (2010) comparison
```{r}
zanne_data <- read.csv("data/zanne_data.csv", header = T)
zanne_native <- native_anywhere_in_australia(zanne_data$Binomial, 
                                             resources = resources) |> 
  right_join(zanne_data, by = c("species" = "Binomial")) |> 
  filter(native_anywhere_in_aus == "TRUE" )



# Calculating same variables on our data
comparison_data <- xylem_areas |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000, 
         total_area = max(area_mm)) |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  summarise(n=n(),
         mean_area = mean(area_mm, na.rm=T),
         n_per_area = n/total_area,
         area_n_ratio = mean_area/n_per_area) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(N = mean(n_per_area, na.rm = T),         # Vessel density
            A = mean(mean_area, na.rm = T)) |>       # Mean area 
  drop_na() |> 
  left_join(namematched[c("apc_name", "family")], by = "apc_name") |>
  distinct()


ggplot() +
  geom_hex(data = zanne_data, aes(x = N, y = A), bins = 15) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "light grey", high = "dark green") +
  geom_point(data = comparison_data, aes(x = N, y = A), size = 1, shape = 3) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Vessel density"~ (mm^-2)) +
  ylab("Total vessel area"~ (mm^2)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


ggsave("figures/zanne_plot.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 15.94, units = "cm")
```


## Presentation figures
```{r}
ggplot(data = xylem_Dh, aes(x = MAP, y = mean_Dh)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, col = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  # facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)") + 
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 16)) +
  geom_text(aes(200, 120, label = "R^2 == 0.06"), parse = T, check_overlap = T, size = 5, hjust = 0, vjust = 0) + 
  geom_text(aes(200, 120, label = "n == 356"), parse = T, check_overlap = T, size = 5, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5)

ggsave("figures/Dh_MAP.png", scale = 1, width = 16, height = 12.07, units = "cm")
```
